testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-hyperlink-read-review-on-pdp.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify hyperlink read review on pdp

scenario.summary: Guest searches a product by SKU, opens its PDP, follows Read Reviews and Write a review, checks the Product Review form labels and buttons, submits a 4-star review, then reopens the PDP Reviews tab and expects the new review (headline, user, comments) at the top.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the product SKU and open the result; assert breadcrumb Home/<category>/<name> and the product heading.
Open Read Reviews, then Write a review.
Assert the Product Review form heading, labels (Review for, Rating, Review headline, Review, Your name, Your state/country), disclaimer and Submit Review / Cancel buttons; the form names the product.
Fill rating, headline, comments, name and state and submit; assert the success alert.
Reopen the PDP, open the Reviews tab (with a reload) and assert the first review shows the submitted headline, "By <name> in <state>," and comments.
stateChanges: Creates a product review (rating 4, headline, comments, reviewer name and state) on the product as a guest; every run adds another review.
assertions: Breadcrumb equals Home/<category path>/<product name>; heading equals the product name.
Review form shows the fixed heading, labels, disclaimer and button texts; Review for contains the product name.
Alert contains the submit success message ('Review submitted successfully.').
The first review on the Reviews tab shows the submitted headline, the reviewer line and the comments.
evidence: Title 'verify hyperlink read review on pdp' and step labels '1) Open PDP -> Read Reviews -> Write a review form' .. '4) Reopen PDP -> Reviews tab -> verify the review' match the flow.

Profile: productSKU z-1234579 FOUND as BundleProduct, active, PRODUCTION, inventory 28362, storefront index 1, no required add-ons; productName matches 2 rows (z-1234579, z-345678). The product type is incidental to the test (any PDP product works); PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK keeps today's record as the preferred one.

Review inputs (rating, headline, comments, reviewer name/state) are created by the test; submitSuccess and reviewUserDisplay are asserted texts (reviewUserDisplay is built from reviewerName/reviewerState).

Missing key: the test expects a guest review to show on the PDP right after submit, so the store must publish reviews without manual approval (review moderation setting). No vocabulary key covers a store with that review setting; the need is left out.

Missing output: the breadcrumb asserts productCategory (Tools / Power Tools); PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK has no category name/path output (outputs: sku, name, productId, price, addOnProductId, addOnName).
strategy migrate: loadData is used, but productCategory (a data value in the breadcrumb assertion) maps to no output of PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK, so swap rule 2 fails.

sources.value: All submissions are reviewed and must be approved
